svg.title: Matched comparison of complete human-plus-technical architecture design workflows
svg.desc: One declared architecture study definition feeds two complete human-plus-technical workflows: an AI-assisted workflow and the strongest practical alternative. The comparison fixes the architecture question, starting artifacts and source access, shared evaluation tools, evaluator-owned acceptance checks, conditions, cost-accounting window, budgets, stopping rules, and reporting requirements. Each workflow returns a supported architecture outcome or declared failure, stated limits, a resource-cost record, and results across repeated runs and varied conditions, including failed runs. Task-paired differences in outcome and cost estimate the effect of adopting the complete AI-assisted workflow conditional on the matching assumptions and tested envelope. They do not isolate a component or narrower AI contribution. The program claim status does not authorize architecture commitment.
